def load():

def rotcw(g): return [list(r) for r in zip(*g[::-1])]
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # shape cells
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==8]
    key=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (0,8)]
    i0=min(i for i,j in cells); i1=max(i for i,j in cells)

    kh=key[-1][0]-key[0][0]+1 if False else max(i for i,j,c in key)-min(i for i,j,c in key)+1
    kw=max(j for i,j,c in key)-min(j for i,j,c in key)+1
    k0i=min(i for i,j,c in key); k0j=min(j for i,j,c in key)
    b=(i1-i0+1)//kh
    bw=(j1-j0+1)//kw
    # key grid

    for i,j,c in key: kg[i-k0i][j-k0j]=c
    # block map = key rotated CW

    BH,BW=len(mp),len(mp[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for bi in range(BH):
        for bj in range(BW):
            if mp[bi][bj]:
                for i in range(i0+bi*b, i0+bi*b+b):
                    for j in range(j0+bj*b, j0+bj*b+b):
                        if grid[i][j]==8: out[i][j]=mp[bi][bj]
    return out
